abstract: A 44-year-old male was diagnosed in August 1980 as having a retroperitoneal germ cell tumor (classic seminoma with anaplastic areas). After treatment with cisplatin-based chemotherapy, he reached complete clinical and pathological remission. Eighty-eight months later, in December 1987, he was diagnosed as having a testicular mixed germ cell tumor (embryonal carcinoma with anaplastic seminoma areas) after right orchiectomy. The potential mechanisms by which the latter tumor could have developed are discussed.
abstract_ja: 1980年8月に、44歳の男性が後腹膜胚細胞腫瘍(未分化成分を伴う古典的セミノーマ)と診断された。シスプラチン併用化学療法を施行し、臨床的および病理学的に完全寛解に至った。その88か月後の1987年12月、右精巣摘除術後に精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍(未分化セミノーマ成分を伴う胎児性癌)と診断された。後者の腫瘍が発生しえた機序について考察する。
